mainEntity.name: Will my bookkeeper use the software I already have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We match you with a bookkeeper experienced in your existing platform — Xero, QuickBooks Online, MYOB, Reckon, or others. There is no need to migrate or re-train your team. If you want to switch software, the matched bookkeeper can also help with that, but it is never forced.

mainEntity.name: Can a bookkeeper lodge my BAS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — a registered BAS Agent can prepare and lodge your Business Activity Statement. Our matched bookkeepers are registered BAS Agents where required, and their TPB registration is verified before they join the network.

mainEntity.name: How much does a bookkeeper cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bookkeeping fees vary by location, complexity, and software. As a guide, small businesses typically spend $400–$1,200 per month for ongoing bookkeeping, though catch-up work or payroll-heavy businesses can be more. The matched bookkeeper will give you a clear quote after reviewing your needs — the matching service itself is free.

mainEntity.name: What if I'm months behind on my books?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is one of the most common reasons people use our matching. Tell us in the questionnaire that you need catch-up bookkeeping and we will connect you with a bookkeeper who specialises in bringing overdue books current — even multiple years behind.

mainEntity.name: Can a bookkeeper handle my payroll and STP2?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many bookkeepers in our network process payroll and manage Single Touch Payroll (STP2) reporting. Tell us in the questionnaire that you need payroll support and we will match you with a bookkeeper who offers that service.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched bookkeeper contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched bookkeeper will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.
Yes. The matching service is free for businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched bookkeeper.

mainEntity.name: Can a bookkeeper also do my tax return?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only a registered tax agent can charge a fee to lodge a tax return. A registered BAS Agent can lodge your BAS but not your income tax return. If you need both bookkeeping and tax return services, we will match you with a firm that offers both.

blocks.heading: Bookkeeper — what we can help with
blocks.text: SPECIALIST NETWORKBookkeeper — what we can help withWhat is the difference between a bookkeeper and a tax accountant?A bookkeeper handles the day-to-day recording of transactions — invoices, bills, bank reconciliation, payroll, and BAS preparation. A tax accountant takes those records and lodges returns, gives structural advice, and manages ATO strategy. Many businesses need both. Our matching service identifies which you need — or whether a single firm that offers both is the best fit — based on what you tell us in the questionnaire.Software you already useWhether your books live in Xero, QuickBooks Online, MYOB, Reckon, or a spreadsheet, we match you with a bookkeeper fluent in your platform. There is no forced migration, no learning curve for your team, and no need to re-train staff on new software. The bookkeeper you are matched with simply logs in and picks up where you left off.Why industry experience mattersA bookkeeper who works with hospitality knows your POS integration, gift-card liabilities, and surcharge-on-weekends quirks. One who works with trades knows progress invoicing, tool depreciation, and retention on quotes. Our matching prioritises bookkeepers with experience in your industry so your numbers are coded correctly the first time — not corrected six months later at tax time.
